text:
Source-assisted reading of Stams, Frg. 78 (F-1m6r), made with Friedberg, Corpus iuris canonici II, cols. 941-942 (Liber Sextus 1.3.10-11) and the Turin 1588 glossed Liber Sextus, cols. 33-38, available. Reread on the native images: face r (canvas 0) column b entire (boxes 3230,1150,4180,2200 and 3230,2150,4180,3200); line ends of the face r pasted strip (box 2660,1150,3220,2250); face v (canvas 1) column a lines 1-13 (box 3780,1100,4750,2150) and, in an independent check, its lower half lines 1-5 and 10-13 (boxes 3780,2080,4720,2600 and 3780,2550,4720,3100); face v column b entire (box 4780,1100,5300,3100); face v upper gloss lines 1-7 (boxes 2950,560,3850,1000 and 3800,560,4720,1000); face v lower gloss, 20 lines (boxes 3000,3420,4950,3930 and 3000,3880,4950,4500); and, in the independent check, 14 lines of the face r upper and right-margin gloss (boxes 3250,630,4150,1020; 4100,630,4980,1020; 4280,980,4990,1480). The rest of the face r gloss rests on the image-only first reading. Expansions in parentheses; ? = uncertain; [..] = lost or unread; [x] = supplied from the edition.
